_label: SYNTHETIC CASES authored for plan kensaku-v1-2 (EV-019). Expected Stripe Checkout Session create parameters for stripe@23.1.0, apiVersion 2026-10-28.endive (research/stripe-2026-11-23.md S1-S27). Not captured from a live Stripe call. Frozen at approval.

rules.builder: buildCheckoutSessionRequest(order, { port, now }) in src/commerce/session-request.ts returns { params, options }. The test deep-equals both against each case's expected value. No other parameter may be present.
rules.name: line_items[].price_data.product_data.name = 'Simulated: ' + productName, where productName is trimmed, cut to its first 120 Unicode code points (not UTF-16 units), and trimmed again at the end.
rules.description: line_items[].price_data.product_data.description = 'Simulated Kensaku purchase in a Stripe sandbox. No order is placed with <observed.merchantHost> and no real payment is taken. Demo price copied from the price last observed on <observed.merchantHost> at <observed.retrievedAt>.' Both host mentions and the time come from the line's observed snapshot, never from line.merchantHost.
rules.currency: Lowercase ISO code on every price_data (there is no top-level currency parameter: the session's currency comes from its line items). unit_amount is the line's demoUnitAmountMinor.
rules.urls: success_url = http://127.0.0.1:<port>/?checkout=success&order=<orderId>&session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID} (the braces are literal; Stripe substitutes them). cancel_url = http://127.0.0.1:<port>/?checkout=cancelled&order=<orderId>.
rules.expiry: expires_at = floor(now / 1000) + 3600 (60 minutes; Stripe allows 30 minutes to 24 hours, research S15, and the margin absorbs clock skew and latency).
rules.fixed: mode 'payment' (no top-level currency); adaptive_pricing { enabled: false } (no conversion, S19); client_reference_id = orderId; metadata and payment_intent_data as in the cases. No payment_method_types (removed in stripe 23, S7), no customer, no images, no allowed_payment_method_types.
